content.text:
The self-check machines now get their card numbers accepted with spaces or dashes in them. All 60 tests pass, including a new one.

The fix is in `lib/members/accounts.js`. I added `normaliseCardNumber`, which strips spaces and dashes, and `findMemberByCard` now uses it before comparing. It works the same way as `normaliseBarcode` does for barcodes. A scanned `2123 4000 5678 90` now matches the stored `21234000567890`, so the checkout goes through instead of coming back as `unknown-member`.

I added a test to `test/sip2.test.js` that checks a checkout with the card written as `2123 4000 5678 90`, `2123-4000-5678-90` and a mix of both. Each one lends the book to the right member.

Any other code that calls `findMemberByCard` will also accept spaced or dashed numbers. Nothing else calls it today.

My first attempt, a Python script that edited both files in one go, was blocked by the permission check. I redid it with the edit tool. I haven't committed anything.
